'''''Ritam''''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] that was passing by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] customs platform. The corvette was inspected by a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] to find that it contained [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] as it had claimed in the manifest and was allowed to leave.
